fusions.name: Last Straw
fusions.desc: A horn-first shove that deals 26 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound and [Poisoned] for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Warning Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps a forefoot, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 25% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stands in the Road
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow to Rile
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 36% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
